description: Top Holders. Calls only GET /v4/tokens/{mintAddress}/top-holders and returns that response. Solana API endpoint for fetching top token holders and whales. Get ownership %, USD value, and labels for top 1000 wallets, updated every 3 hours.

limit.description: Limit of the number of transfers to return per page. Default/max is 1000.

mintAddress.description: Typed Solana public key identifier used across request parameters and response fields. Path parameter for /v4/tokens/{mintAddress}/top-holders.

sortByAsc.description: Sort ascending by 'rank', 'ownerName', 'ownerAddress', 'valueUsd', 'balance' or 'percentageOfSupplyHeld'. Only one of `sortByAsc` or `sortByDesc` can be used

sortByDesc.description: Sort descending by 'rank', 'ownerName', 'ownerAddress', 'valueUsd', 'balance' or 'percentageOfSupplyHeld'. Only one of `sortByAsc` or `sortByDesc` can be used

name: get-token-top-holders
title: Top Holders
